headline: Trade Desk CEO Overrides Shareholder Opposition on Stock Option Repricing
summary: The Trade Desk's chief executive moved forward with repricing executive stock options, overriding opposition from institutional investors.
why: The Trade Desk is a prominent US ad-tech platform; decisions on executive compensation that override shareholder sentiment frequently prompt corporate governance scrutiny.

impacts.name: The Trade Desk Inc
impacts.why: Repricing options despite shareholder opposition can trigger governance disputes and investor pushback.
